name: Unity Solar
old_description: Unity Solar is your trusted Northwest solar installation company serving Washington and Oregon homeowners. Get a no-hassle solar estimate and see how much you can save with Unity Solar.
about:
Unity Solar operates from Vancouver, Washington, serving homeowners and businesses across the Pacific Northwest. The company was established as a solar installation division of Unity Electrical Services, a residential and commercial electrical contractor; no founding year or individual founders are disclosed in public materials.

The firm installs photovoltaic systems for both residential and commercial customers, handling 100 percent of installations with its own crews rather than subcontracting. Through its parent electrical company, it also provides full-scope electrical services including wiring, panel upgrades, and code compliance. Specific facility size, headcount, and annual installation volumes are not published.

Unity Solar’s customer base includes homeowners in dozens of Washington and Oregon communities — among them Vancouver, Camas, Washougal, Olympia, Longview, and Centralia — as well as commercial property owners. The company also participates in utility programs such as Clark Public Utilities’ Solar Energy Program.

The company emphasizes three differentiators: direct accountability for a 25-year workmanship warranty (not outsourced to third parties), a no-pressure sales approach that provides estimates without obligation, and the technical depth of an established electrical contractor backing every solar project.
